course.title: GAIA · ATLAS · Physical World Sensors
course.tagline: Attested IoT pins, LIVE vs SIM honesty, and operator map reads — physical world as capability.

m1.title: What a LIVE relay is
m1.concept: HTTPS allowlist, offline-on-fail, never invent readings.

m2.title: Licence & commercial rail
m2.concept: CC0 / CC BY / OGL / PD only — why AirNow waits and OpenAQ ships.

m3.title: Fleet & pin honesty
m3.concept: Open-Meteo ≠ station; public AIS ≠ own-edge; warning ≠ in-situ.

m4.title: ATLAS operator map
m4.concept: Read a fleet catalog, layer counts, and priced SKUs from the map.

m5.title: Capstone: add a sensor
m5.concept: Walk Recipe A — device id, source URL, ATLAS mirror, redeploy order.

site.quickstart_intro: Clone the repo, install deps, and run labs locally or in Colab.
site.certificate_intro: Certificates are issued only by the CLI after every exercise stub passes — not by ticking boxes in the browser.
site.certificate_locked: Fill # YOUR CODE stubs in courselib/exercises.py, then run python labs/run_exercises.py --certificate "Your Name".
site.footer: Part of the AIMarket ecosystem — GAIA (iot.modelmarket.dev) and ATLAS (atlas.modelmarket.dev) as a live physical-world sandbox.

lab01_live_vs_sim.hint: Compare om-wx-01 (LIVE, source set) vs ws-01 (SIM). Check: python labs/run_exercises.py --module m1

lab02_licence_gate.hint: Gate OpenAQ vs AirNow / BY-NC. Check: python labs/run_exercises.py --module m2

lab03_honesty_claims.hint: Reject Open-Meteo-as-station claims. Check: python labs/run_exercises.py --module m3

lab04_atlas_map_read.hint: Assert nearest payload has distance_km + id. Check: python labs/run_exercises.py --module m4

lab05_add_sensor_capstone.hint: Checklist must include licence, redeploy, honesty. Check: python labs/run_exercises.py --module m5
